title: Example: choose a color when highlighting a verse
summary: A second example plan, for a different change. Highlighting a verse used to always make it yellow. Now a row of five colors appears, and the color you pick is remembered for next time.

setup.title: Start the app on your computer
setup.body: If you have the code checked out, run this in the project folder, then open the address it prints. Otherwise use the **Open Seed Bible** button above.

setup.title: Go to a chapter
setup.body: Open **Psalm 23** from the book picker. The tests below use this chapter.

tests.title: The color row appears when you highlight
tests.why: This is the main change in the pull request.
expected: A row of five colored circles appears: yellow, green, blue, pink and orange.
Yellow has a check mark on it.

tests.title: Tapping a color highlights the verse in that color
expected: Verse 1 now has a green background.

tests.title: The last color you used is remembered
tests.before: You need the green highlight from the previous test.
expected: Green has the check mark this time, not yellow.

setup.title: Make the window phone-sized
setup.body: Use a phone, or narrow your browser window until the sidebar turns into a menu button.

tests.title: All five colors fit on screen
expected: All five colors are visible without scrolling sideways.
Each circle is big enough to tap without hitting its neighbor.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: Removing a highlight still works
tests.before: You need the green highlight on verse 1.
expected: Verse 1 goes back to having no background color.

notCovered: Highlights syncing between devices. That code didn't change in this pull request.
